fact_text: The State Bank of Pakistan's policy rate was 11% going into the 15 Sep 2025 monetary policy decision.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The analyst expected the State Bank to hold the 11% policy rate unchanged, though some in the market had flagged a possible hike because of flood crop losses.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Flood losses were estimated at about 300 to 400 billion, just under 1% of GDP, according to the estimate the analyst cited.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Rice plantations near the river areas were reported about 15% destroyed by the floods, and other crop losses were also significant.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The analyst expected Pakistan to receive flood-related financing from multilateral agencies, and noted the IMF was also assessing the financing options.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The analyst's method was to compare food-sector P/E multiples against peers, since a good company is not always a good investment at any price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Smile Industries was cited at a projected P/E of about 25 times, described by the analyst as a fast-growing food company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: National Foods sells spices, pickles and other natural food products through departmental stores and has plants in Karachi and Faisalabad.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: National Foods, a stock with Rs 5 face value, was cited at a P/E of roughly 24 to 25 times, which the analyst called consistent with its record.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: National Foods' annual earnings were cited at about 13 to 14 rupees per share.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Rafhan Maize was cited at a P/E of about 11 to 12 times, among the lower-multiple food stocks the analyst compared.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Murree Brewery was cited at a P/E of roughly 8 to 10 times, one of the lowest multiples in the food and beverage group, and the analyst called that surprising.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Barakat Price and Agro's first annual profit after its IPO came in around 600 to 700 million, against about 600 million projected at the IPO.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Barakat Price and Agro was cited at a P/E of about 17 times, and the analyst described its egg processing as a business-to-business operation using machines.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Prema is a dairy company that crossbred Australian cattle with Pakistani cows, and its short shelf life limits distribution mostly to Lahore and Punjab.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Prema was cited at a P/E of about 20 times against a historical multiple of about 25 to 26 times, and the analyst noted top-line sales growth.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Big Bird Foods was described as having good results, with a product line that includes frozen foods; the P/E figure was not clearly transcribed.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: Pakistani frozen meat and offal exports have grown beyond the Gulf to China and Central Asia, where demand is strong for older animal meat.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company is an export-led meat business selling to the Gulf, China and Central Asia, with offal and by-products among its products.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The analyst said Bakra Eid demand makes the livestock and meat trade visible in the market each year, adding to the sector's seasonal activity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The analyst views Pakistan's meat revolution as a large opportunity, given rural livestock culture and more slaughterhouse activity, with investors increasingly entering the space.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)

fact_text: The analyst linked Pakistan's population growth to steady demand for fast-moving consumer goods, which he said is why food companies tend to grow faster than other sectors.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 15 Sep 2025 | SBP Monetary Policy 11% | Flood Loss Impact | Food & Personal Care Sector' (YouTube, 2025-09-15)
